results.trace: I read src/game.ts:193-253. tick() sets r.view = null at line 201 after every stepWorld. draw() at line 205 rebuilds the view lazily with `r.view ??= raceView(r.world)`. On a zero-tick frame the world hasn't changed, so reusing the cached view is correct, and any frame that does tick clears the cache first. No path serves a stale view.
results.reason: This is a coverage gap, not a defect. The cache-hit branch behaves correctly on this branch, so no test can fail here because of a problem. The finding is about a hypothetical future regression, which is out of scope for verification.

results.trace: I compared old and new src/title.css in the diff hunk. Before the change, `.ui-track-card:focus-visible` set outline and outline-offset, the `[aria-checked='true']:focus-visible` rule set outline-color, and a second `:focus-visible` rule set transform and box-shadow. After the change, transform and box-shadow sit in the first rule (title.css:120-125). The checked rule sets only outline-color, so no property overlaps and the order change can't alter the cascade. The computed styles are identical.
results.reason: The merge is equivalent in the cascade and the focused card looks the same as on main. A missing test for unchanged behaviour is not a defect a failing test could show.
